contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents working across Brian-owned projects
contract.outcome: Prevent complex coding-agent projects from cycling through approvals, plans, repairs, and restarts without durable user-visible progress.

canonical_journey.starting_state: A complex project has supporting work and repeated failure evidence but no restart-safe outcome custody.
canonical_journey.input: One exact claimed session, its selected outcome, and retained predecessor failure evidence.
canonical_journey.action: Resume the lane or deliberately change mechanism without resetting the outcome or evidence scoreboard.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The successor runtime resolves the retained outcome and a causal restart preserves every predecessor failure fact.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: A new session, plan, branch, or scenario silently drops the outcome selection or predecessor failure history.
